newsitem.title: USA: Designer sees '97 sales below expectations.
newsitem.headline: Designer sees '97 sales below expectations.

text.p: Designer Holdings Ltd. said on Wednesday that as a result of a change in its distribution strategy, 1997 sales will fall below prior expectations.

It said it will curtail distribution through certain specialty store chains and Latin American sales channels of the Calvin Klein Jeanswear brand, while increasing its focus on higher-margin department store customers, as well as selected licensees.
Designer Holdings said although gross margins will be enhanced, total sales for the year will be below expectations.
Total 1997 sales are expected to be between $495 million and $510 million, compared with $480.4 million in fiscal 1996.
The company also said it expects to report fiscal 1997 net income of between $0.90 and $0.95 per share as a result of the new strategy. The company earned $0.85 a share in 1996.
